Priority Pass came free with the Revolut Metal plan (€15.99 a month, which I mostly keep for the travel insurance).
Membership number 7731-4402-9918, 4 free visits a year then €32 per visit, guests €32 too. Lisbon T1 only has the
Lounge Mirador on the non-Schengen side, so it's useless for my usual Schengen hops. Best one so far: Sky Terrace at
Helsinki, sauna-style showers and proper salmon soup. Worst: a windowless room at Frankfurt with sad croissants.
Most lounges let you in max 3 hours before departure, and some turn Priority Pass people away when full between 17:00
and 20:00, so screenshot the app's "may be restricted" notice to argue.
